authority.alpha_prerequisite: Continue H-05a toward OBJ-09 and OBJ-10 by projecting the one kernel-owned signal catalogue into the public OpenAPI, coordinated protocol reference, and every supported SDK. This package proves generation and semantic parity only; it does not claim runtime emission, diagnostic activation, build identity, performance, or release readiness.

current_behavior: H05a-01 gives rrd-core one validated catalogue with four diagnostic levels, nine bounded metric attributes, twenty-two metric descriptors, trace descriptors derived from the durable trace catalogues, and fingerprint 239df2ced5974d4351ca01565369646964cb65c63d0fbae01dddccb4c3ac5a07. rrd-contract does not expose that catalogue or fingerprint. The five SDKs generate endpoint identity only, plus TypeScript OpenAPI types. The central generated-surface checker cannot write or verify a signal projection. docs/reference/protocol/public-contract.md reports stale digest 3c016e... while the executable document and OPENAPI_DOCUMENT_SHA256 agree on 1d18655a.... DiagnosticSnapshot is a separate authenticated engine-state view and must remain distinct from observability discovery.
target_behavior: Keep rrd-contract free of production workspace dependencies. Extend the central generated-surface tool to read the kernel's test-verified telemetry fixture, validate its shape and fingerprint identity, and deterministically render a private Rust projection inside rrd-contract before exporting OpenAPI. Embed that generated projection and fingerprint in canonical x-rrd-signal-catalogue and x-rrd-signal-catalogue-sha256 extensions. From the one exported document render a coordinated signal reference and read-only TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, and .NET projections. Generated files carry canonical compact JSON and the two fingerprints rather than independently restating metric or trace semantics. The existing rrd-core dev edge and focused Rust test prove exact live-kernel parity without coupling production layers. Add language tests for 4/9/22 counts, public accessibility, and absence of lifecycle/runtime effects. Correct the public-contract digest, document the remaining H-04 generation gap, regenerate existing OpenAPI-dependent files, navigation, and inventory, and create one linked Gate H journal.
unchanged_behavior: README, objective, roadmap, and POA&M retain their existing authority and status.

rrd-core telemetry.rs remains the only semantic signal owner; its golden fixture and every generated projection are replaceable evidence/discovery artifacts and cannot become metric, trace, lifecycle, planning, or evidence authority.
rrd-contract retains zero production workspace dependencies; rrd-core remains a dev-only parity oracle and no outward client imports a kernel or physical component.

TraceOperation, TraceAttribute, SignalCatalogue validation and fingerprinting, RuntimeTraceEvent, DiagnosticSnapshot, mutation, authorization, receipts, persistence, query, and transport behavior remain unchanged.

The extensions are discovery metadata on the existing /v1/schema/openapi operation; this adds no operation, effect, activation, exporter, subscriber, clock/environment read, network fetch, task, or provider.
Generated output is replaceable and does not constrain exploratory reasoning or activate a client lifecycle.
The five endpoint generators remain for this package; full operation/model generator convergence remains H-04 work.
DiagnosticSnapshot remains an independent bounded state view and gains no signal field.
Cargo.lock, protocol version 1, product version 1.0.0, roadmap/POA&M status, release state, benchmark policy, and official promotion remain unchanged.
